items.title: GDG Zaria Tech Hangout: Shaping Our Community Together
items.text:
Date: 12 December 2026, 15:00 UTC
Ends: 12 December 2026, 17:00 UTC
Location: ABU CONGO CLOSE BASKETBALL COURT, KONGO, ZARIA
Registration: Free registration

About This Event GDG Zaria is entering an exciting new phase of growth, and we are building our roadmap with you not just for you.

We invite developers, UI/UX designers, students, tech founders, and ecosystem builders across Zaria to join us for the GDG Zaria Tech Hangout. This is a high-energy, interactive town hall designed to bring the community together, align on our priorities, and set the foundation for impactful technical events in the months ahead.

What We Will Discuss:

-

Community Direction & Technical Tracks: Share your input on the workshops, bootcamps, hackathons, and study jams you want GDG Zaria to prioritize.

-

Funding & Ecosystem Partnerships: Brainstorm practical strategies for securing local sponsorships, venue partnerships, and resources to keep our community events thriving.

-

Volunteer & Core Team Recruitment: Meet the new GDG Zaria Lead and learn how you can join the organizing team across technical content, partnerships, media/design, and event logistics.

-

Open Networking: Connect with peers, mentors, and fellow builders in the Zaria tech ecosystem.

Who Should Attend? Whether you are a seasoned software engineer, a designer, a student taking your first steps in tech, or a community stakeholder looking to collaborate your voice matters. Pull up a seat and help shape the future of tech in Zaria.
